assetTransfers.scopeNote: Counts include all requests during territory rendering and the post-render pan. Repeated requests are counted in total wire bytes; unique file counts are reported separately. Low used the district-export path and produced higher local transfer totals than normal in this scenario; no claim is made that low quality transfers fewer bytes. These observations are not a target-hardware or bandwidth guarantee.
